author: cat457800

title: Good app but not worth upgrading
body:
If you’re looking for an app that you can use on a day to day basis only then this app is great. But if you want to track monthly habits, then maybe reconsider. 

It’s a good app and it’s really cute so it helps me go on it even though the reminders are easy to ignore. I wish there could be a widget for the app for easy access and to remind me that the app exists. It’s a bit difficult to see if you are making great progress in maintaining/ breaking a habit when there’s only a weekly review of your habits. 

I wish there was a monthly tracker for it as well and even better if there’s a yearly wrap up. The information section of the app is very limited but even so, it’s still good. But for the price they charge, I hope they can add more. 

Lastly, I hope they they can delete the “upgrade” window once you already upgrade. I feel like that room could be used for something else (maybe a monthly tracker? Or a timer?). 

Nonetheless, I think this app has great potential. I just wish that there was more for the price they charge.

author: Sw3lai

title: Love this app - few kinks to work out
body:
I bought the full app & I love it. I use it to keep track of my daily chores, routines, habits, etc. I do however have some suggestions/issues with it. 
It seems that the more tasks you add to the app the more it lags & freezes. For example, when I hit my task that I’ve fed my dog and then I want to hit another task right after, there’s a good solid screen lag before either of them are checked off. And then when I try to leave the screen to see my plant or the water feature it lags. 
Also, I don’t understand how the water feature tracker thing actually works. You can’t click on it & it seems to just increase as you check on the water screen throughout the day. I think it would make way more sense if the user was able to hit the water jar and mark it off themselves. Otherwise it doesn’t really seem to have an accurate account of your water intake. 
Lastly, the little lessons are great and cute but they definitely should have some sort of completion or a different appearance to them once you’ve completed the lesson. It just keeps it more organized and allows you to save time before opening a lesson and realizing you’ve already completed it. 
Oh and I feel like the plant should grow more so based on how many tasks you complete and not just on how many days you complete tasks for. It could be both but ya, just my suggestion. 

Love the way the app looks and the idea of it. It’s super cute.
